Lina (Docs): Quick heads-up: we've drafted a deprecation notice for the non-streaming chat helper methods in our SDKs. Looking for alignment before we publish.
Marco (SDK): Which helpers exactly? The old `client.chat.create()` sync path?
Lina (Docs): Yes. The docs currently show both streaming and non-streaming variants. The proposal: mark the non-streaming helpers as deprecated in docs and samples, recommend streaming APIs for low-latency and token-efficiency.
Priya (Eng): Backend still supports sync endpoints, but streaming is our long-term recommended path. No runtime breaking planned immediately, but we should give a clear migration timeline.
Theo (Product): Recommended timeline: announce now, soft-deprecate in SDK docs (warning banners), support both for 9 months, then start schedule to remove non-streaming helpers from new SDK major versions after 12 months.
Marco (SDK): Okay — SDK plan: ship minor with deprecation notices in docstrings and generated samples this week, add compatibility wrappers that route to streaming under the hood where possible, and include an opt-in to preserve original behavior.
Lina (Docs): Draft banner text on docs site: "Non-streaming chat helpers are deprecated in favor of streaming chat. Both are supported for 9 months. See migration guide." Thoughts?
Priya (Eng): Add a note about performance: streaming reduces tail latency and memory for long chats. Also mention compatibility: existing tokens and payloads unchanged.
Marco (SDK): Need canonical code snippets for both sides. Lina, can you include a short migration example showing synchronous -> streaming conversion?
Lina (Docs): Sure - here's the suggested before/after snippet to include in the migration guide:
```
# before (sync)
resp = client.chat.create(
  model="r-chat-001",
  messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

# after (streaming)
for chunk in client.chat.stream(
  model="r-chat-001",
  messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]
):
  print(chunk.delta, end="")
```
Include guidance on buffering if users previously relied on full-response semantics.
Theo (Product): Comms: include one-liner for CSMs: "No sudden break - sync helpers continue to work for 9 months; streaming is recommended for production chat due to lower latency and cost."
Marco (SDK): Will add deprecation badges to the SDK method docs and create PRs: js-sdk and py-sdk. I'll link PRs here when created.
Priya (Eng): Ops: we'll expose a metrics tag for requests that use streaming vs non-streaming so customers can see migration progress in Console. We'll also add an event to the telemetry pipeline.
Lina (Docs): Adding a short FAQ: "When should I switch?" answer: if you need lower latency, incremental UI rendering, or long-context cost savings.
Marco (SDK): Requesting tests for the compatibility shim - will need Eng to sign off on any behavior differences.
Priya (Eng): Will review tests. Also will keep server-side aliasing for payload fields to avoid accidental breakage.
Lina (Docs): Timeline recap: publish docs notice + migration guide today, SDK sample PRs this week, SDK minor releases next Wednesday, console banner next Friday, 9-month support window, start removal conversation at 12 months.
